summary: Validated Customer Support site-menu backend + UI flows. Backend regression tests passed for GET/PATCH site-menus and support/contact disabled + missing-Resend-key failures. UI verified Customer Support configuration renders contact-form controls and FAQ add/edit/reorder/delete controls for admins.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/support/contact correctly reads resend_api_key and resend_to_email from _get_push_settings(), returns 403 when contact_form.enabled=false, and returns explicit 503 when resend_api_key is missing.
Support email recipient/subject/HTML are server-controlled in submit_support_contact; client only provides name/email/message via SupportContactBody.
GET /api/push/settings masks Resend/Telegram secrets and only exposes *_set flags + masked values; raw secrets are not returned.
PATCH /api/site-menus preserves get_help when only faq_items/contact_form are updated; FAQ order is persisted according to payload order.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (requested Customer Support UI controls and interactions validated; no server-save performed)

seed_data_creation: None. UI interactions intentionally not saved to avoid persistent data changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: If re-running UI checks, use data-testids: nav-store, store-site-menus, customer-support-configure-btn, faq-add-button, faq-question-{i}, faq-answer-{i}, faq-move-up-{i}, faq-move-down-{i}, faq-delete-{i}. Backend regression command: pytest -q /app/backend/tests/test_site_menus_support.py --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iteration34_site_menus_support.xml
rca of the issue: Original POST /api/support/contact error was previously due missing endpoint. Current implementation exists and behaves correctly in no-key environment by failing safely with explicit 503 about missing Resend API key, without attempting live sends.
